verdict.rationale: Rev AI's public get-started tutorial walks through the async Speech to Text API: submit an audio file, then retrieve the transcript (including a plaintext command). Webhooks can signal completion with no human polling, and an llms.txt index makes the docs agent-readable. However, the evidence pack never shows the API-key auth step, and there is no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths return 404). missing for 10: explicit evidence of API-key authentication in the flow, a published OpenAPI spec, independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent completes the flow from docs alone.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent holding an API key can take a recording from submission to finished transcript (auth, job creation, result retrieval) from the public docs alone, with no human step in between

citations.quote: This tutorial uses the Asynchronous Speech to Text API to produce a transcript of an audio file submitted by you.
Alternatively, you can get the plaintext version by running the command below
use webhooks to asynchronously receive notifications once the transcription job completes.
